**WCCF 2010-11 (Rev D) on a PC - {TITLE}.** Community-made tools for your own copy of the game: a launcher,
stand-ins for the cabinet's hardware and an on-screen panel, so the game's server, the projector and a player
cabinet (seat 1) run on one Windows PC - or play online on a shared server. The game is not included. Download
**{ZIP}** below.

### Updating
Close the game, unzip the new kit over the old folder (your club, keys and settings stay), then `SETUP.exe` again,
and `ENGLISH.exe` again if you use English. From a kit with `.bat` files: delete the old `PLAY.bat`, `STOP.bat`,
`SETUP.bat` and `ENGLISH.bat` - the `.exe` files of the same names replace them.

### You need
Windows 10/11 (64-bit) · your own copy of the game, Rev D, as a folder of files · DirectX June 2010 runtime (setup
tells you if it is missing). Python is inside the kit.

### Play
`PLAY.exe` (two windows: the projector and seat 1). Quit by closing the game's window. Online: SETTINGS > NEXT
START: **ONLINE**, type the server's address, then **RESTART NOW** (click it twice).

The zip's SHA-256: `{SHA256}`
